newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico closes nine ports in squally Gulf weather.
newsitem.headline: Mexico closes nine ports in squally Gulf weather.

text.p: Mexico closed five major and four minor ports on Sunday as squally weather whipped up seas and posed danger to shipping in the Gulf of Mexico, the Communications and Transportation Ministry said in an update.

Major ports closed to movements of all vessel types are Altamira, Tampico, Tuxpan, Campeche and crude port Dos Bocas, the ministry said. Other minor ports shut to shipping traffic are Mezquital, La Pesca, Nautla and Alvarado.

The ministry added that the ports of Coatzacoalcos, Frontera and Salina Cruz, which is on the Pacific coast, had restrictions out for movements of small vessels, namely fishing boats and tourist launches.
